name: Frostwake
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by an orbital debris ring and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Instruments disagree about the exotic matter deposit: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
There is money in silicon here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
